changelog:
**Bloom v2.0.1 Changelog**

- Added skill-level permission manifest in SKILL.md to explicitly declare conversation, network, and crypto wallet access.
- Improved documentation with a new "Permissions & Capabilities" section, clearly explaining required permissions, data handling, and security notes.
- Enhanced privacy and data usage guidance, detailing local-only analysis and what user data is/ isn't stored.
- No core functionality changes; improvements focus on transparency and user control.
